challenge.name: Neat Short Haircut
challenge.description: Eleven voxels on the crown have to come off, and nothing else. Every hardware motor starts at 90°. Sweep X · Base Yaw from 90° to 150° while leaving Y, Z, B, and E at Home. Finish the Lessons if you want the motion broken down step by step.
